jobs.title: Senior Event Planning Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As Event Planning Manager , you accompany the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover and ensure that every event is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Precise creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Contact person for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operation. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-design of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, as well as at least three years of experience in hotel events or event planning, ideally focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with demanding guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and stylistically confident German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.title: Event Manager (80–100 %)
jobs.description: The Goldau Nature and Animal Park delights around 450,000 visitors annually. On 42 hectares, around 100 European wild animal species live. Approximately 200 employees and numerous volunteers are committed to nature and species conservation, education, and research, and sustainably develop the scientifically managed animal park. Do you combine entrepreneurial thinking with a passion for events and hospitality? In this key position, you are responsible for the event business from the first customer enquiry to successful on-site execution. In doing so, you actively develop our event offerings and create special experiences in a unique natural setting. We are looking for a personality to join us immediately or by arrangement as Event Manager (80–100 %) Your tasks You are responsible for the acquisition, planning, organisation, and execution of events from A to Z You prepare and negotiate offers, contracts, and calculations and develop schedules You coordinate events with internal departments and lead or instruct the involved employees You maintain existing customer relationships, acquire new customers, and identify sales and additional sales potential You further develop the event offering and design new, attractive formats for day, event, and seminar guests You manage one employee and coordinate the staff deployed for events Your profile Education or further training in event management, hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism with relevant professional experience Several years of experience in independently planning and implementing demanding events Sound knowledge of gastronomy and a strong understanding of operational processes, quality, and service Strong organisational and coordination skills as well as a structured, reliable, and independent working style Entrepreneurial thinking, creativity, and a good sense for attractive offers and market potential Resilience and calmness, even with several simultaneous events Our offer Responsible role with scope for design and decision-making and the opportunity to actively further develop the event offering Meaningful work in a unique environment with nature and wildlife Diverse event portfolio with different customer groups Appreciative leadership culture and collaboration with committed employees Modern infrastructure and attractive employment conditions with various fringe benefits Application and contact We look forward to receiving your complete application documents, including your expected annual gross salary. For questions, Simon Widmer, Head of Hospitality, is happy to assist you at 041 859 06 31 .

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de compte dans le domaine des ventes et des événements (h/f)
jobs.description: Rent.Group est un acteur majeur facilitant la possession temporaire et l'utilisation circulaire en Europe. Grâce à plus de 1 150 collaborateurs répartis sur 30 sites dans 11 pays européens et à des décennies d'expérience, nous sommes un moteur du changement – vers une société de partage circulaire globale avec des bénéfices écologiques et sociaux. Avec trois divisions sous un même toit et une sélection de plus de 6 000 catégories de produits et plus de 7 millions d'articles individuels, nous aidons nos clients à aménager leur intérieur et leurs espaces pour créer à chaque fois l'atmosphère parfaite qui inspire les gens – lors d'événements, de salons et au bureau. Avec passion, créativité et un souci constant de qualité, nous accompagnons nos clients dans toute la Suisse pour la planification et la réalisation d'événements, de salons ou de solutions de bureau. En tant que partie intégrante de Rent.Group, active à l'échelle européenne, nous créons des événements inoubliables avec une atmosphère unique et recherchons un gestionnaire de compte engagé dans le domaine des ventes et des événements (h/f). Ta mission : En tant que gestionnaire de compte dans le domaine des ventes et des événements (h/f), tu es le premier point de contact pour nos clients – du premier contact jusqu'à la réussite de leur événement. Tu sais construire des relations clients, développer des concepts créatifs et présenter nos produits de manière convaincante. Tes tâches : Prospection et développement de nouveaux clients Planification, calcul et réalisation autonomes des projets – de la phase conceptuelle à la mise en œuvre réussie Élaboration des offres et gestion des commandes en tenant compte de la rentabilité et de la satisfaction client Collaboration avec notre équipe logistique et design Ton profil : Expérience en vente, idéalement dans le secteur de l'événementiel, de l'hôtellerie ou du design Orientation client marquée, excellentes compétences en communication et en négociation Méthode de travail structurée, orientée objectifs et entrepreneuriale avec un grand sens des responsabilités Passion pour la création, les tendances et les concepts événementiels innovants Très bonnes connaissances de MS Office et idéalement expérience avec des systèmes CRM Maîtrise courante de l'allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit indispensable, connaissances en français ou en anglais souhaitées Permis de conduire catégorie B Ce que nous offrons : Un environnement dynamique et créatif avec une hiérarchie plate Projets passionnants avec des clients renommés issus de l'économie, de la culture et de la politique Grande autonomie et marge de manœuvre Influence directe et prise de décision rapide Perspectives d'évolution Bonus lié à la performance Prêt à repenser les événements ? Nous attendons ta candidature avec impatience ! Ta personne de contact est Vanessa Dittmann.

jobs.title: Sous Chef Event & Catering Kitchen (m/f/d) 100%
jobs.description: Fancy gastronomy with adrenaline? Forget dusty gastro standards: At Ullrich Hospitality AG based in Arlesheim BL, we create experiences that stay in the memory! As one of the leading event catering companies in Switzerland, we bring unique concepts to life - from stylish galas and exclusive corporate events to thundering large-scale events with up to 6,500 guests and cool street food projects. Whether in our own event locations or on site with our clients. We combine the strength of a market leader with the freedom and dynamism of a modern lifestyle company. With us, you won’t find a rigid routine but a young, ambitious team with a genuine hands-on mentality: We support each other, think differently and deliver top performance where the celebrations happen. Are you looking for a place where you can fully invest your energy, actively shape things and grow beyond yourself together with us? Welcome to the world of Ullrich! Ullrich Hospitality is part of Ullrich Enterprise AG . Under its umbrella, two other companies operate. Besides the event sector, we are also strong in back office: Ullrich Treuhand GmbH manages mandates from various industries and ensures order and clarity - from financial accounting to controlling and human resources. Ullrich Konzepte GmbH acts as a strategic driver, supports companies in business development and develops innovative gastro concepts that go far beyond the ordinary. Do you want not only to stand at the stove but actively shape the culinary future of the Swiss event industry? In our kitchen, you won’t find dusty routine: We tinker with innovative food concepts, rock the biggest events in the country together and create moments that remain memorable. You are a sous chef personality with pronounced leadership, organisational and executive experience, have deep gourmet understanding and are looking for a real key role as the right hand of our chef de cuisine - and all that without tedious curfews? Then you are exactly right at Ullrich Hospitality! As Sous Chef (m/f/d) 100% , you form a strong leadership duo together with a second sous chef directly alongside our chef de cuisine. You take co-responsibility for the operational kitchen management, administrative planning and leadership of our core team as well as the variable seasonal crew. Your tasks with us: Right hand of the chef de cuisine: You actively support our head chef in planning, organisation and concept development. In his absence, you take overall leadership as deputy of the head chef. Operational support & team guidance : You work closely with the head chef and the second sous chef. Together you lead our fixed core team of 6 employees (including 2 apprentices) in catering production and at event assignments. Flexible seasonal team : Depending on the season, event volume and workload, you get more involved in operational business and ensure the training and guidance of our variable employees. Quality & gourmet feeling: You ensure that every dish - from exclusive business caterings to impressive large-scale events - meets the highest gourmet standards in taste and appearance. Planning & admin: You have administrative processes under control (duty planning, production planning, recipe standardisation, compliance with HACCP and hygiene guidelines, etc.) and ensure structured workflows on site. Event & catering assignments: You actively assist at caterings and events throughout Switzerland - in our own locations and on site with our clients. Requirements Training & experience: Completed training as a cook EFZ as well as solid experience in gourmet/star gastronomy. Catering & event experience: Ideally, you already have experience in the event catering sector and keep a cool head even in high dynamics. Leadership & organisation: You bring extensive leadership experience, have already led larger teams and independently managed administrative planning and organisation. You have experience in clearly guiding variable employees as reinforcement of the core team during seasonal peaks and ensuring uniform standards. Open personality: You are an inspiring, communicative and winning personality - in short: a real doer who likes to be at the forefront, enthuses their team and does not disappear into the background. Language skills: Very good German and good English skills for smooth communication in the multinational team. Benefits No curfew: With us, you work in continuous shifts instead of fragmented working days. No hours of waiting between shifts - so your free time really remains your time. Company holidays: Two weeks of company holidays in summer as well as two weeks over Christmas and New Year for your recovery are always fixed. Top location & infrastructure: Modern workplace on the dynamic site in Arlesheim directly at the recreational area of the Birs (perfect for breaks by the water). Plenty of parking spaces on site and excellent public transport connections. Strong team spirit: Dynamic environment with flat hierarchies, open informal culture and team events that bond. Ready to help shape the top of our kitchen? Send us your complete application and bring your experience to Ullrich Hospitality!

Antonietta looks forward to your application and is happy to take time for your questions at +41 32 344 69 44. In our recruitment process, professional and personal qualifications are paramount, so photos and personal details may be omitted from the application.
